title: Amp Skill Format
description: JSON Schema for Amp Skills - reusable patterns with optional tools and MCP servers

name.description: Skill identifier (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens only)

description.description: Brief overview of functionality and when to use it

argument-hint.description: Hint shown for skill invocation arguments (e.g., '[query]')

disable-model-invocation.description: When true, prevents the model from auto-invoking this skill

content.description: Markdown content with instructions and examples

frontmatter.name: code-review
frontmatter.description: Reviews code for best practices and potential issues

examples.content:
# Code Review Skill

Reviews code for:
- Best practices
- Potential bugs
- Performance issues

## Usage

Provide a file or directory path to review.
